name: Kommo Salesbot Text Capture Runner v1

nodes.name: Configurar Cuenta Kommo1
nodes.notes: Single source of truth for the Kommo domain. Priority: KOMMO_BASE_URL, incoming body['account[_links][self]'], incoming body['account[subdomain]'], KOMMO_ACCOUNT_SUBDOMAIN, placeholder. Webhooks can still send legacy *.amocrm.com URLs, so account[_links][self] is preserved when present.

nodes.name: Fetch Pipelines1
nodes.notes: GET /api/v4/leads/pipelines. Pagination follows _links.next.href and preserves all returned IDs and stages.

nodes.name: Fetch Custom Fields1
nodes.notes: GET /api/v4/leads/custom_fields. Includes required_statuses and enum metadata.

nodes.name: Fetch Salesbots1
nodes.notes: GET /api/v4/bots. Critical migration export: scripts, triggers, actions, and raw internal bot logic are preserved.

nodes.name: Fetch Leads Sample1
nodes.notes: GET /api/v4/leads?limit=50&with=contacts. This intentionally captures one sample page of 50 leads for schema validation and edge-case detection. Kommo's Leads list docs currently document contacts in the with parameter; company links are preserved when present in the raw lead payload.

nodes.name: Consolidate Kommo Snapshot1
nodes.notes: Final single output item. Normalizes structures while preserving the raw object for each pipeline, field, tag, salesbot, and sample lead.

parameters.query:
WITH normalized AS (
  SELECT
    id,
    session_id,
    CASE
      WHEN message->>'type' = 'human' THEN 'human'
      WHEN message->>'type' = 'ai' THEN 'assistant'
      ELSE COALESCE(message->>'type', 'unknown')
    END AS role,
    btrim(
      regexp_replace(
        regexp_replace(
          regexp_replace(
            regexp_replace(
              regexp_replace(message->>'content', '[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}', '[EMAIL]', 'g'),
              '(https?://|www\.)\S+', '[URL]', 'g'
            ),
            '(\+?\d[\d\s().-]{7,}\d)', '[PHONE]', 'g'
          ),
          '\b\d{6,}\b', '[NUMBER]', 'g'
        ),
        '\s+', ' ', 'g'
      )
    ) AS content
  FROM public.n8n_chat_histories
  WHERE message ? 'content'
    AND message->>'type' IN ('human', 'ai')
    AND btrim(message->>'content') <> ''
), eligible_sessions AS (
  SELECT
    session_id,
    COUNT(*) AS message_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE role = 'human') AS human_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE role = 'assistant') AS assistant_count,
    MIN(id) AS first_message_id,
    MAX(id) AS last_message_id
  FROM normalized
  GROUP BY session_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) BETWEEN 4 AND 80
     AND COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE role = 'human') >= 2
     AND COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE role = 'assistant') >= 2
  ORDER BY MAX(id) DESC
  LIMIT 10
)
SELECT
  'sample_' || ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY e.last_message_id DESC) AS sample_id,
  md5(e.session_id::text) AS session_hash,
  e.message_count,
  e.human_count,
  e.assistant_count,
  e.first_message_id,
  e.last_message_id,
  jsonb_agg(
    jsonb_build_object(
      'role', n.role,
      'content', n.content
    )
    ORDER BY n.id ASC
  ) AS transcript
FROM eligible_sessions e
JOIN normalized n ON n.session_id = e.session_id
GROUP BY
  e.session_id,
  e.message_count,
  e.human_count,
  e.assistant_count,
  e.first_message_id,
  e.last_message_id
ORDER BY e.last_message_id DESC;
